statistics.macro: first mean four tasks within each training seed, then aggregate training seeds

protocol_notes: Training uses a seeded 90/10 random split at the clip level rather than the episode level.
Evaluation uses the original benchmark data-sampling protocol; episode-disjoint generalization is outside this protocol.
timing: Warmed synchronized batch-one complete planning, 5 warmups/20 repeats; loading/preprocessing/simulation/graph setup excluded and recorded separately.
